content: The surveillance note for period 10 of Thames Auto Receivables 2026-1 plc indicates a breach of the 90+ day arrears ratio at 1.32%, up from 1.20% in the previous period. Principal is now paid sequentially due to a trigger event. The North West region holds 80.0% of the 90+ day arrears balance, with 9.3% of its balance 90+ days in arrears.
